note: `fontdict_copy_source.witness_owner_ptr_before` and `fontdict_copy_dest.witness_owner_ptr_after` are semantic witness views over the vulnerable inline-to-heap copy range in `hb_vector_t<CFF::CFF1FontDictValues, 8u>::alloc()`: the instrumentation scans copied `static_array[i].values.arrayZ_` slots from high to low, chooses the highest copied non-NULL owner as the witness before `memcpy`, and re-reads the corresponding `new_array[i].values.arrayZ_` after `memcpy`. The bound expressions therefore use `i` as the copied witness-slot coordinate rather than a literal vulnerable source variable name. The sink-side operands are direct vulnerable-original expressions from `hb_vector_t<CFF::OpStr, 8u>::fini()`.
